ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity pixels (white fields on outer lobes) and 65% low-intensity pixels (central dark pigmentation and shadows).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features a dominant contiguous high-intensity white field with scattered dark punctate marks; central region is a solid low-intensity dark mass; right lobe consists of a white background heavily overlaid with discrete, dark-intensity circular blobs concentrated toward the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, approximately 42 degrees, with significant depth relative to the posterior fluke margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular serrations (saw-tooth pattern) with prominent peaks; left lobe trailing edge shows lower-amplitude, high-frequency serrations with smoother segments toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature with a pronounced upward-tapering sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of dark-on-white circular markings (rosettes) localized on the right lobe; sparse, smaller clusters visible on the medial-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) detected in the dark-pigmented region immediately lateral to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy textured calcification and irregular protrusions consistent with barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity spray/splash artifacts at the fluke-water interface partially occluding the lower peduncle area.
